en.text: I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.
He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我的 神啊，你所行的奇事，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，你所行的奇事，

en.text: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.
I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

zhSimplified.text: 我的 神啊，我乐意照你的旨意行；

zhTraditional.text: 我的上帝啊，我樂意照你的旨意行；

en.text: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.

zhSimplified.text: 我在大会中宣传公义的佳音；

zhTraditional.text: 我在大會中宣傳公義的佳音；

en.text: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

zhSimplified.text: 我未曾把你的公义藏在心里；

zhTraditional.text: 我未曾把你的公義藏在心裏；

en.text: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你不要向我止住你的慈悲！ （诗70）

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你不要向我止住你的慈悲！ （詩70）

en.text: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

zhSimplified.text: 因有无数的祸患围困我，

zhTraditional.text: 因有無數的禍患圍困我，

en.text: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. to help me, LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你开恩搭救我！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你開恩搭救我！

en.text: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

zhSimplified.text: 愿那些寻找我、要灭我命的，一同抱愧蒙羞！

zhTraditional.text: 願那些尋找我、要滅我命的，一同抱愧蒙羞！

en.text: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

zhSimplified.text: 愿那些对我说阿哈、阿哈的，

zhTraditional.text: 願那些對我說阿哈、阿哈的，

en.text: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”

zhSimplified.text: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜！

zhTraditional.text: 願一切尋求你的，因你高興歡喜！

en.text: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. my God.

zhSimplified.text: 但我是困苦穷乏的，主仍顾念我；

zhTraditional.text: 但我是困苦窮乏的，主仍顧念我；
